scenes.heading: Why the rains arrive

scenes.rationale: Seasonal contrast without presenting ITCZ movement as the sole trigger.

scenes.heading: The land warms first
scenes.summary: Land heats faster, helping lower continental pressure.
scenes.rationale: Illustrates thermal contrast between land and ocean.

scenes.heading: Ocean moisture moves inland
scenes.summary: Moist air flows inland as invisible vapour.
scenes.rationale: Shows atmospheric moisture transport from ocean to land.

scenes.heading: The rain belt shifts
scenes.summary: Northward rain-belt movement helps organize summer circulation.

scenes.heading: Two ocean pathways
scenes.summary: Moisture arrives via Arabian Sea and Bay.
details: Somali Jet helps transport moist air.
Weather systems can carry Bay moisture inland.

scenes.heading: Cooling builds rain clouds
scenes.summary: Rising air cools; condensation forms clouds that can rain.
details: Cooling helps vapour condense into cloud droplets.
Cloud droplets can grow into rain.
scenes.rationale: Distinguishes cloud formation from possible precipitation.

scenes.heading: Mountains add a lift
scenes.summary: Western Ghats force winds upward, enhancing rain.
scenes.rationale: Shows orographic lift on windward slopes.

scenes.heading: The rain shadow
scenes.rationale: Illustrates dry leeward side vs wet mountains.

scenes.heading: The summer rain season
scenes.summary: Typically reaches Kerala around early June.
scenes.rationale: Uses rain belt imagery to signify the onset of the wet season.

scenes.heading: Active spells and breaks
scenes.summary: Active spells and breaks partly follow monsoon trough shifts.
details: Rain is more widespread during active conditions.
Rain weakens over many areas during breaks.
scenes.rationale: Contrasts rainfall rhythms without an unsupported nationwide causal sequence.

scenes.heading: Tendencies, not guarantees
scenes.summary: ENSO influences rainfall; outcomes are never guaranteed.
details: Often a tendency toward reduced monsoon rainfall.
A tendency toward stronger monsoon rainfall.
scenes.rationale: Contrasts probabilistic impacts of ENSO phases.

scenes.heading: Food and water depend on it
scenes.summary: Monsoon links weather with food and water.
scenes.rationale: Crop imagery directly illustrates agricultural dependency.

scenes.summary: Northeast monsoon brings rain to southeast.

scenes.rationale: Uses moisture transport asset to avoid consecutive reuse of A08.

scenes.heading: Follow the connections
